title: Nuxt: file-based routing, layouts and auto-imports

videos.script:
Until now the planner has been a Vue application you assembled yourself: a router you listed, imports you wrote, a Vite configuration you edited. Today the same planner is built a second time, with Nuxt. {{nuxt}} Nuxt is Vue, Vite and a server, held together by rules about where files go.

{{create}} You will create the project, read a warning about the Node you are running, and update it, checking the download against its published checksum. Then you will read an audit report that says seven, and find that it means one.

{{pages}} Then pages, where a file's path is its address, and a missing address is a real 404. {{layouts}} Then layouts, the frame around every page, and an error page of your own. {{imports}} Then the planner's parts brought over, with fewer lines than they had, because Nuxt imports for you, and you will look at where it writes those imports down.

{{server}} Then a server route, an API in the same project. {{planner}} And last, the week and the course pages again, reading their data from that server, so a tick in one browser is there in the next.
